texts: A dozen sky-cats roost on the cliff-spires.
The Keepers cannot count the sky-cats exactly.

q2_gaps: symbol form for a SOLID/CLOSED-spelled compound ('nightmoth'): the instruction set mandates the genus atom for such spellings but never says whether the compound symbol keeps the solid surface form (nightmoth) or is respelled as modifier_noun (night_moth), so two spellings of one word can land on different symbols
review.notes: Both arguments are bare kind-denoting plurals, so the opaque kind-level relation at (STV 0.9 0.9) is the prescribed route, with both compound genera at definitional 1.0 0.99 and the noun modifiers (sky, night) correctly left unexposed. Eat is a licensed kind-level relation head.

q1_issues.issue: The parse file is zero bytes: no atoms at all were emitted for the sentence, so neither the generic subject, the verb, nor the negation is recorded anywhere.

q2_gaps: a negative-quantifier DIRECT OBJECT ('eat nothing'): the negated verbal generic form covers a missing or definite object, but nothing licenses binding an object slot to 'no entity at all' inside a strength-0 bundle or rule

exceptive 'else' ('nothing else' = nothing besides what has already been mentioned): the focus-particle inventory covers only / even / also / clefts and has no carrier for the alternative-set exclusion, so the restriction cannot be encoded and dropping it would widen the claim to 'sky-cats eat nothing'
review.notes: Nothing could be judged against the instruction set because the output is empty; this may be a run artifact rather than a translator decision to drop an unencodable claim.

issues.reason: The observation is factually right but is not a defect: with no carrier for an object-position negative quantifier and none for exceptive "else", every partial encoding drops the "else" and widens the claim to the false "sky-cats eat nothing", and Core patterns directs exactly this outcome — carry the restriction, or "leave the whole claim out and record the gap" — so a zero-atom output violates no stated rule and puts nothing false or over-asserted into the KB.

gaps_confirmed: a negative-quantifier DIRECT OBJECT ("eat nothing"): the strength-0 bundle and the negated verbal-generic rule have no way to bind an object slot to "no entity at all"

exceptive "else" ("nothing else" = nothing besides what was already mentioned): the focus-particle inventory (only / even / also / cleft) has no carrier for alternative-set exclusion, and dropping it widens the claim
new_gaps: an atoms-only output format gives the parser no way to mark "unencodable, deliberately left out": a licensed omission and a failed run produce byte-identical artifacts, so the pipeline cannot tell a correct empty parse from a crash
adjudication.notes: Judged as an artifact against the instruction set; whether the empty file came from a deliberate omission or a failed run cannot be read off the parse or the verdict. A later instruction set with an exceptive carrier would make this sentence recordable.

review.notes: The bare-plural generic correctly becomes a Skolem-function distribution rule at 0.9/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase companion, and the hyphenated compound emits its genus with the noun modifier left unexposed. 'alone' as a how-adverb Manner is the closest licensed slot; a concurrent depictive state is the only other reading.

q1_issues.issue: "together" is slotted as (Manner (sk_roost $x) together), but the instruction set names bare "together" a collectivity marker (one event with multiple Agent atoms) and never a manner adverb, so the atom both invents a Manner filler and asserts that each sky-cat's own roosting is done together.

q2_gaps: A bare-plural GENERIC clause carrying a collectivity marker ("Sky-cats roost together"): the collective form needs a group or coordinated subject to hang multiple Agent atoms on, while the generic route mints a per-member distributing rule that the marker contradicts, and no carrier for collectivity inside a distributing rule is defined.
review.notes: The sky_cat compound genus (noun modifier unexposed, head genus emitted) and the 0.9/0.9 bare-generic rule with a Skolem-function event are correct; only the "together" handling is at issue.

issues.reason: Manner takes only how-adverbs of manner proper and 'a mis-slotted Manner atom asserts a manner the sentence does not state'; bare 'together' is named a collectivity marker (one event, multiple Agent atoms), and on a per-member Skolem event the atom says each individual sky-cat's own roosting is done together, which is false.

gaps_confirmed: a bare-plural GENERIC clause carrying a collectivity marker ('Sky-cats roost together'): the collective form needs a group or coordinated subject to hang multiple Agent atoms on, the generic route mints a per-member distributing rule the marker contradicts, and no collectivity carrier inside a distributing rule is defined
new_gaps: what a licensed form would have to carry here: kind-level collective participation (members roost WITH one another) that does NOT distribute onto a single member's event — the pairwise reciprocal rule is the only existing shape and it would falsely assert that every pair of sky-cats roosts together
adjudication.defect_summary: Compliant form: the same bare-plural distributing rule with the Manner atom simply omitted — the stated fallback for an adverb with no licensed slot ('leave them out and record the gap'); no licensed form preserves the collectivity itself, which is the gap filed above.
adjudication.notes: The sky_cat compound genus and the 0.9/0.9 Skolem-function generic rule are correct; only the 'together' slot fails.

fields.sentence: A dozen sky-cats roost on the cliff-spires.

q2_gaps: a settling/resting verb such as "roost" is not in the enumerated bare-position postural class (lie / sit / stand / hang / lean / perch / rest), so whether the clause mints no event at all (position atom only, verb lemma discarded) or reifies an eventuality is unsettled — the whole predicate's survival turns on that boundary

how an entity-attached position atom (surface-preposition head such as On) applies to a counted-plural / group subject is unspecified: the distributive machinery is stated only for events and for copular / Member properties, so per-member rule vs. a group-level position atom vs. both is undetermined
review.notes: "a dozen" as the exact fixed value 12 on the group, both compound genera, the definite-plural spires as a group witness, and On as the entity-attached surface preposition (LocatedIn being containment-only) are all correct; the verb roost has no symbol anywhere in the parse, which is licensed only if the bare-position route applies.

fields.sentence: The Keepers cannot count the sky-cats exactly.
parse: (: lo401_count_neg (And (Member sk_count_1 count) (Agent sk_count_1 sk_keepers_1) (Theme sk_count_1 sk_cats_1) (Manner sk_count_1 exactly) (Can sk_count_1)) (STV 0.0 0.99))

q2_gaps: no test for when a capitalized PLURAL kind-word label ('the Keepers') is 'referring as a name' - which would make it a Name-only individual with no GroupOf and no per-member kind - versus an ordinary definite plural of that common noun; the singular-collective default is spelled out, but the plural carve-out's trigger is left entirely to judgment
review.notes: The negated group capability keeps both emissions at strength 0.0 with the prescribed 0.99/0.9 confidence split, and sky_cat gets its head genus with the noun modifier correctly unexposed. 'exactly' as Manner sits close to the 'degree adverb on a verb has no licensed slot' bar, though it does answer 'how'.

Definite plural plus copular predicate correctly distributes over (PartOf $x sk_group_1) with the Degree atom inside the conclusion at STV 1.0 0.9, avoiding both Inheritance on the kind and a property on the group symbol; no QuantifierPhrase, since no quantifier word appears.
